volcano.name: Pulosari

volcano.name: Karang
volcano.about: Gunung Karang volcano in westernmost Java was constructed SE of the 15-km-wide Pleistocene Danau caldera.

volcano.name: Perbakti-Gagak
volcano.about: The Perbakti-Gagak volcanic complex, also known as Kiaraberes-Gagak, is a cluster of deeply eroded stratovolcanoes situated immediately SW of Salak volcano.

volcano.name: Salak
volcano.about: The forested Salak volcano was constructed at the NE end of an eroded volcanic range.

volcano.name: Gede-Pangrango

volcano.name: Patuha
volcano.about: The forested andesitic Gunung Patuha rises SW of the plain of Bandung in western Java.

volcano.name: Tangkuban Parahu

volcano.name: Papandayan

volcano.name: Guntur

volcano.name: Tampomas

volcano.name: Galunggung

volcano.name: Talagabodas

volcano.name: Ciremai

volcano.name: Slamet
volcano.about: Slamet is one of Java's most active volcanoes.

volcano.name: Sundoro

volcano.name: Sumbing
volcano.about: Gunung Sumbing is a stratovolcano that is the SE-most edifice of a chain of volcanoes in central Java that includes Sundoro and the Dieng Complex.

volcano.name: Merbabu
volcano.about: Gunung Merbabu is a massive forested volcano north of Merapi in central Java.

volcano.name: Merapi

volcano.name: Lawu

volcano.name: Kelud

volcano.name: Kawi-Butak

volcano.name: Arjuno-Welirang

volcano.name: Penanggungan

volcano.name: Semeru

volcano.name: Tengger Caldera

volcano.name: Lamongan

volcano.name: Iyang-Argapura

volcano.name: Raung

volcano.name: Ijen

volcano.name: Baluran

volcano.name: Agung

volcano.name: Rinjani

volcano.name: Inielika

volcano.name: Egon
